text: 商务部欧洲司负责人解读中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会成果：双方同意发挥贸易监测机制作用，探讨双方在世贸组织规则框架下降低部分商品关税可能性，并就欧盟外国补贴条例开展技术对话，为中欧贸易投资合作营造公平、透明、可预期的环境。双方愿在此前良好合作的基础上，就医疗器械和农产品等领域的市场准入问题进行交流，并继续就欧盟对逆变器项目融资指导文件、化妆品和药品监管等问题保持沟通。双方就电动汽车、混动汽车贸易进行了深入讨论，避免了局面升级，有力维护了中国企业的实际出口利益和中欧混动汽车贸易的稳定发展。
text_en: An official of the European Affairs Department of the Ministry of Commerce interpreted the outcomes of the second meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: both sides agreed to leverage the trade monitoring mechanism, explore the possibility of reducing tariffs on certain goods under the framework of WTO rules, and hold technical dialogue on the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation, so as to foster a fair, transparent and predictable environment for China-EU trade and investment cooperation. On the basis of previous sound cooperation, both sides are willing to exchange views on market access issues in areas such as medical devices and agricultural products, and to continue communication on issues including the EU guidance document on financing for inverter projects and cosmetics and pharmaceutical regulation. The two sides held in-depth discussions on trade in electric vehicles and hybrid vehicles, averting an escalation of the situation and effectively safeguarding the practical export interests of Chinese enterprises and the stable development of China-EU hybrid vehicle trade.
